title: EE-Motion: An EEG-based Web Architecture for Live Affective Music Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.21032v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Music listening is intrinsically tied to emotion, which drifts continuously within a single session. Although modern browsers interface with wearable brain-computer interfaces, recommendation systems remain structured around discrete logs and lack the infrastructure to integrate continuous physiological signals. Furthermore, existing affect-aware models rely on static user profiles and offline training, failing to serve anonymous newcomers without model retraining. We present a web platform that resolves both challenges. Pairing with a consumer electroencephalogram (EEG) headband over Web Bluetooth, the system captures live EEG, mapping frontal alpha asymmetry and arousal index to normalized valence-arousal proxy coordinates on Russell's circumplex plane. translated_title: EE-Motion：一种基于脑电图的实时情感化音乐推荐网页架构
translated_abstract: 音乐聆听与情绪本质上紧密相连，而情绪在一次聆听会话中会持续漂移。尽管现代浏览器已能够与可穿戴脑机接口交互，但现有推荐系统仍围绕离散的日志记录构建，缺乏整合连续生理信号的基础设施。此外，现有的情感感知模型依赖于静态用户画像和离线训练，无法在不重新训练模型的情况下服务匿名新用户。我们提出了一个同时解决这两个挑战的网页平台。该系统通过 Web Bluetooth 与消费级脑电（EEG）头带配对，实时采集脑电信号，将额叶 alpha 不对称性与唤醒指数映射到 Russell 情绪环形平面上的归一化效价-唤醒代理坐标。在这些坐标的驱动下，一个情感适配器将结构各异的推荐后端统一到共享的实时评分机制之下。通过对匿名访客进行参数化……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了EE-Motion，一个通过Web Bluetooth连接消费级EEG头带、实时将脑电信号映射为效价-唤醒情绪坐标，并借助情感适配器统一多种推荐后端、无需重新训练即可为匿名用户提供实时情感化音乐推荐的网页架构。
en_tdlr: This paper presents EE-Motion, a web architecture that pairs with consumer EEG headbands via Web Bluetooth to map live brain signals onto valence-arousal coordinates, using an affective adapter to unify diverse recommendation backends for real-time emotion-aware music recommendation of anonymous users without model retraining.
